verdict.rationale: Capsule CRM has a documented REST API with developer docs covering authentication, but nothing in the evidence shows an interactive API reference or runnable examples (such as a try-it console or API explorer). Probes for an OpenAPI or Swagger spec all returned 404. An interactive reference is a fair axis for a SaaS product with a public API, so absence of evidence yields none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
